trainers.instruction: This is a map of Central Africa. Select the building to learn more.

instruction.text: Read the text and select the matching image.

atoms.a: As Angola’s capital, Luanda serves as the country’s economic hub and is experiencing rapid growth.
Angola’s history as a former colony is reflected in Luanda’s Portuguese architecture.
Luanda has a big divide between rich and poor, with many crowded neighbourhoods of informal housing.
Kizomba is a style of music and dance that comes from Angola. It is often danced in the streets of Luanda.

atoms.b: Mount Cameroon is an active volcano on the Atlantic coast. It is the ((++highest lowest)) point in Central Africa at just under 4,100 metres.

Mount Cameroon ((++erupts floods)) roughly once every 13 years, which is considerably more than most other volcanoes. It also produces a huge amount of ((++lava water)), which solidifies into rock around it.
The volcanic ash in the soil contains many ((++minerals gases)). This makes the area around Mount Cameroon perfect for growing bananas, one of the country’s most important exports.

trainers.instruction: Mining is an important part of the economy in the Central African Republic. Listen and select the correct description.

b.sound: Diamonds provide the majority of the country’s income.
Wheat provides the majority of the country’s income.
The Central African Republic is also rich in a radioactive element called uranium.
The Central African Republic is also rich in a radioactive element called coffee beans.
These resources are often mined in poor conditions with basic tools, which is very dangerous.
These resources are often mined safely by huge machines, which is very efficient.

instruction.text: Drag the boat along the Congo River.
Read the text and answer the questions.

hint.label: Capital cities
text: Brazzaville, the Republic of the Congo, and Kinshasa, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, are situated a 15-minute boat crossing away from each other on either side of the River Congo.

atoms.text: The Congo River is the second-longest river in Africa. The river flows through the Democratic Republic of Congo and forms much of the border with the Republic of Congo. It supports both countries’ capital cities, which sit directly across the river from one another.

The Congo River is a very important transport network for the Democratic Republic of Congo, where less than 5% of roads are paved. However, overcrowding, poorly maintained boats and a lack of timetables means that getting around is not always easy.

The Congo River also supports the surrounding Congo rainforest: the second-largest rainforest in the world. It is a diverse ecosystem home to over 10,000 plant species and the largest population of gorillas in the world.

atoms.a: Which two countries does the Congo River separate?
Why is it not always easy to travel using the Congo River?
b: ++The boats do not run on fixed schedules.
The boats are overcrowded 5% of the time.

atoms.a: Why is the Congo rainforest an important place for gorillas?
b: ++It is home to the world’s largest population.
It is home to world’s second-largest population.
It is home to the world’s smallest population.
